acquisition_method.evidence: Mass spectra were acquired on a Q Exactive HF (Thermo Fisher Scientific) mass spectrometer operated by data dependent acquisition (DDA) using a top 30 selection count.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Digestion was stopped by heat inactivation, samples were then acidified with 0.1 % formic acid and stored at −80°C.

collision_energy.evidence: An isolation window of 1.2 m/z was used for selection, a normalized collision energy of 30 was set, and higher energy collision induced dissociation (HCD) MS/MS spectra were acquired at 15000 resolution.

ionization_type.evidence: To minimize the batch effects experienced with chromatography column and nano-ESI detector signal loss, the samples were randomly analyzed in sets of three injections until twelve injections were collected for all UPS1 spiked-in concentrations, with blank injections performed between each set.

labeling.evidence: inferred: For each spiked-in concentration, 12 identical injections were analyzed.
